sentences.text:
Vijaybahadur @ Vijayram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12
September, 2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Gwl:15682
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 12 th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 39548 of 2024
 Vijaybahadur @ Vijayram
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
Appearance:

Shri Pavan Kumar Vijaywargiya - Advocate for the applica
 Shri Aps Tomar- Public Prosecutor for respondent/State.
 Shri Dharmendra Singh Kushwah- Advocate for the complain

Order 
IA No.19868 of 2024,

an application under Section 338 (2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, moved on behalf of complainant seeking permission of this Court to assist the prosecution in the matter is taken up, considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein.
Shri Dharmendra Singh Kushwah, learned Counsel appearing for complainant along with his Associates is permitted to assist the prosecution in the matter.

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for grant of bail relating to Crime No.155/2024 registered at Police Station Gormi,
District Bhind (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 450, 376, 506 IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that as per prosecution story,
incident

is of 22.06.2024 while the FIR has been lodged after 20 days on 14.07.2024 and no explanation for such inordinate NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15682 2 MCRC-39548-2024 delay in filing FIR has been put forth.

It is also submitted that there was previous relation between prosecutrix and the applicant but when it is seen by the younger son of the prosecutrix then after consultation FIR has been lodged after 20 days.
It is also submitted that as per medico-legal report, no external injury has been seen and no sign of rape has been found by the concerned doctor.
Challan has been filed in the matter.
Further custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required.
There is no criminal antecedent against the applicant.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

1
Per contra, learned counsel for the State as well as complainant opposed the bail application on the ground that the prosecutrix is a widow lady.
She was at her home in the night.
The present applicant entered in the house of the prosecutrix and committed rape.
It is further submitted that the offence is heinous one and thus prayed for rejection of the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed but with certain stringent conditions and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
In case, if he is found involved in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial;
6) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be; and 7 ) The applicant shall appear before the concerned police station once in every fortnight till conclusion of trial.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE pd Vijaybahadur @ Vijayram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129643689/
